title: Repair isolated child homes in native-path and publication tests
goal: Reuse the existing test_env::isolate_home helper in the three callers reported by the full public gate while preserving native path and credential fixtures.

reuse.searched: susi_paths::test_env::isolate_home and the three existing child process fixtures reported by child_home_isolation. The helper preserves caller-set XDG and instance settings and disables registry environment fallback.

limitations: Test isolation repair only. Core size remains above99999 and this task does not certify a release.
